Name: Soren Kierkegaard
Summary: Danish philosopher and theologian who attacked a state church that made Christianity easy, and wrote of Abraham, love, and the single individual before God.
Contribution: Gave Christian thought its sharpest critique of comfortable Christendom and its classic account of faith as inward, personal trust.
KeyWorks: Fear and Trembling; Either/Or; Works of Love
Testimony: He testified that faith is not a crowd's inheritance but a leap the individual must make before God.
